title: delegate lint proxy and introduce release bridging
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: Reduce presubmit latency and noisy runs caused by full-matrix linting while preserving strict release-time checks. This PR introduces a lightweight lint-proxy service that accepts staged lint 'handshakes' from CI runners and performs deferred heavy linting on dedicated lightweight runners, and a release-bridging step (release quarantine) that gates merges into a release window with a short TTL and automated revalidation. Changes also include dependency bumps for eslint (8.x -> 9.x), @typescript-eslint, and action templates for GitHub Actions that make the new flow reusable across repositories. High-level goals: 1) reduce feedback time for developers by running fast syntax/typo checks inline and offloading slower rule sets; 2) ensure release merges run a single canonical heavy lint job and a quick revalidation of changed files; 3) provide observability and cost tagging for presubmit work so we can tune runner fleet. Checklist: [x] implement lint-proxy microservice with health and metrics endpoints; [x] add staged-handshake GH Action composite that talks to lint-proxy; [x] create release-quarantine GH workflow with TTL and canary revalidation; [x] bump eslint and lockfiles; [x] update CONTRIBUTING.md to document new merge flow; [x] add smoke job to release pipeline to catch flakiness; [ ] follow-up: propagate composite to SDK repos. Related: linear/ENG-7123 link: https://linear.app/issue/ENG-7123, engineering doc: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/ci/lint-proxy (internal). This description contains a compact summary of commits, files changed, reviewer discussion, and CI outcomes below.

notes_for_release_manager: This PR is safe for normal release windows. The release-quarantine TTL is 15 minutes by default; release managers can override to 30 minutes via workflow inputs if performing a large-batch release. See docs/CONTRIBUTING.md for procedure.

testing_instructions: Local dev: run .github/actions/composite/staged-handshake/action.yml in dry-run mode; start lint-proxy with 'scripts/ci/deploy-lint-proxy.sh --local' then run presubmit-fast workflow target. To validate release flow, trigger .github/workflows/release-quarantine.yml with a test tag and observe canary revalidation step.
